title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Discover the unique rituals and historic practices of the 'Harvard of the Proletariat,' from the recitation of the Ephebic Oath to the passing of the 1875 Loving Cup.

cards.title: The Ephebic Oath Recitation
cards.subtitle: A Civic Pledge at Commencement
cards.notes: Recite this historic Athenian-inspired pledge during commencement to vow lifelong devotion and service to the betterment of New York City.
cards.short_summary: A traditional civic pledge recited by graduates at commencement, emphasizing devotion to New York City.
cards.evidence_claim: At commencement each year, City College students participate in a long-standing tradition of reciting the Ephebic Oath, pledging devotion to the City of New York.
cards.source_title: Some Uniquely CCNY Commencement Traditions | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the main commencement ceremony on the South Campus Great Lawn.

cards.title: The 50-Year Loving Cup Handover
cards.subtitle: A Generational Symbol of Loyalty
cards.notes: Witness the ceremonial passing of this engraved silver trophy, bequeathed every 50 years to bridge the gap between generations of alumni.
cards.short_summary: A silver trophy bequeathed by the Class of 1875 to be passed down every 50 years as a symbol of loyalty.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 1875 Loving Cup was bequeathed to the graduating class 50 years in the future; it was passed to the Class of 1925, then 1975, and is held in trust for 2075.
cards.source_title: Some Uniquely CCNY Commencement Traditions | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Ceremonially displayed and passed during milestone Homecoming and Commencement events.

cards.title: Singing 'Lavender, My Lavender'
cards.subtitle: The Official School Song
cards.notes: Join the chorus of the official school song, written in 1901, which punctuates every commencement as graduates depart their alma mater.
cards.short_summary: The official school song of CCNY, written in 1901 and sung consistently at every commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Since 1919, 'Lavender, My Lavender' has been the only song, other than the national anthem, sung consistently at CCNY commencements.
cards.source_title: Some Uniquely CCNY Commencement Traditions | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Performed at all official college ceremonies, including Freshman Convocation and Commencement.

cards.title: The Lavender Ceremony
cards.subtitle: LGBTQIA+ Achievement Celebration
cards.notes: Participate in this cultural celebration to receive a lavender cord and rainbow tassel, honoring the achievements of LGBTQIA+ graduates.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony celebrating the academic and personal achievements of LGBTQIA+ students and allies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lavender Ceremony is a cultural celebration that recognizes LGBTQ+ students and acknowledges their achievements with lavender cords and rainbow tassels.
cards.source_title: Lavender Ceremony | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May at Aaron Davis Hall; registration is required for graduates.

cards.title: The Great Hall Convocation
cards.subtitle: Academic Procession and Welcome
cards.notes: Walk in the academic procession through the historic Great Hall to be officially welcomed by the President and faculty in full regalia.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome ceremony for incoming freshmen, featuring an academic procession in the Great Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Annual Freshman Convocation occurs each September in the Great Hall and features an academic procession of deans and faculty in academic regalia.
cards.source_title: Freshman Convocation | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Held every September in Shepard Hall's Great Hall for the incoming freshman class.

cards.title: The Concrete Canoe Launch
cards.subtitle: Grove School Engineering Tradition
cards.notes: Join the Grove School of Engineering to design and race a functional canoe made entirely of concrete in regional and national competitions.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing engineering tradition where students build and race canoes made of concrete.
cards.evidence_claim: The Concrete Canoe club from The Grove School of Engineering is an old CCNY tradition where teams build canoes out of concrete to see if they float.
cards.source_title: CCNY students go the distance in Concrete Canoe | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: The club operates out of the Grove School of Engineering; competitions occur annually in the spring.

cards.title: Benny the Beaver's Appearance
cards.subtitle: Symbol of Industry and Endeavor
cards.notes: Look for Benny the Beaver at athletic events; he was chosen in 1934 to represent the intelligence and industry of the City College student body.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of CCNY, selected in 1934 as a symbol of intelligence and industry.
cards.evidence_claim: In 1934, the beaver was selected as the mascot for City College as a symbol of intelligence, industry, and earnest endeavor.
cards.source_title: City College of New York - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Appears at various CUNYAC athletic games and major campus spirit events.

cards.title: The Graduate Mural Viewing
cards.subtitle: Symbolic Passing of Wisdom
cards.notes: Study the massive Edwin Blashfield mural in the Great Hall, which depicts the Alma Mater passing the torch of wisdom to a young scholar.
cards.short_summary: A historic mural in the Great Hall that serves as a symbolic backdrop for major academic ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Edwin H. Blashfield's original mural titled 'The Graduate' anchors the Great Hall, depicting the passing of wisdom from The Alma Mater onto a young scholar.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Visible during events in the Great Hall of Shepard Hall; access depends on building hours.

cards.title: The Townsend Harris Medal Gala
cards.subtitle: Honoring Distinguished Alumni
cards.notes: Attend the annual Alumni Gala to see the presentation of the Townsend Harris Medal, the highest honor for graduates' career accomplishments.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition honoring outstanding alumni with the Townsend Harris Medal at a formal gala.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alumni Association honors alumni for career accomplishments with the esteemed Townsend Harris Medal during the Annual Alumni Gala.
cards.access_notes: The gala is a ticketed event held annually, often in Shepard Hall or external venues.

cards.title: Five Demands Commemoration
cards.subtitle: Student Activism Legacy
cards.notes: Visit the Archives to view artifacts from the 1969 student takeover, a recurring theme in campus exhibits that honors the fight for open admissions.
cards.short_summary: A recurring historical exhibit and commemoration of the 1969 student protest that led to open admissions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Archives & Special Collections Room showcases materials from the Five Demands student protest and takeover of the campus in 1969.
cards.source_title: City College Exhibit Covers Student Life History - Harlem View
cards.access_notes: Located in the NAC building, Room 5/301; check library hours for access to the Archives.
